title: Aquatiers Tagger
description: The official tier tagger of aquatiers.org
body:
## Aquatiers Tagger
Offical tier tagger mod of [AquaTiers](https://aquatiers.org/)

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

The Aquatiers Tagger is a mod that shows a player's tier for any gamemode tested on AquaTiers. All tiers are located [here](https://aquatiers.org/), and all tier testing happens on the official Discord, found on the right side.

This plugin works by defaulting to showing the player's highest tier next to their name.
![Shows the player's highest tier next to their name](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/bf7ec7d1df1b34d25503b82bf55bc345b6588ab9.png)

To see every tier a player has, just do **/aquatiers user <user>** to pop up a menu _(seen below)_

![/aquatiers user <user>](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/46dc34d06199cee4ae688fc4a67c9f7ce034d666.png)

To change the tagger to only show one gamemode on nametags, just do **/aquatiers mode <mode>**.

## Supported Versions

This mod currently only officially supports **1.21.8-1.21.11**, but may work with lower versions. (DO AT YOUR OWN RISK)
